verses.pali: Adhammikā ca parisā dhammikā ca parisā …pe… imā kho, bhikkhave, dve parisā.
verses.english: An unprincipled assembly and a principled assembly …

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imāsaṁ dvinnaṁ parisānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammikā parisā”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two assemblies is the principled assembly.”
